sloka: पृष्ट्वा कुशलम् अव्यग्रम् वैदेहो मिथिलाधिपः ।कौशिक अनुमते वाक्यम् भवन्तम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६८-६॥
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā kuśalam avyagram vaideho mithilādhipaḥ ।kauśika anumate vākyam bhavantam idam abravīt ॥1-68-6॥

translations.english: "O Great monarch Mithila's lord, king Janaka, with the sacred fire in front again and again enquires about your health and the spiritual wellbeing of your preceptors, priests and attendants in words filled with sweetness and affection.
